$comment: Optional env merge for Claude Code inside Desktop / the claude CLI. Chat in the Claude macOS/Windows app (2026) does NOT use ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL — use Help → Troubleshooting → Enable Developer Mode, then Developer → Configure Third-Party Inference (Gateway, https://127.0.0.1:8787, key local-dev, scheme x-api-key). apps-write-claude-desktop merges this env without wiping mcpServers/preferences and writes ~/.config/inja-gateway/claude-desktop-3p.json for Import. KEY=local-dev is the gateway edge key; subscription OAuth lives on the gateway.
